title: Analysis code for: Associations of self-reported arthritis with out-of-pocket medical spending across four harmonised ageing cohorts

creators.name: Wang, Kai
creators.affiliation: Department of Rheumatology and Immunology, The Affiliated Huai'an No. 1 People's Hospital of Nanjing Medical University, Huai'an, Jiangsu, China

description:
Analysis code for a multi-cohort study of self-reported arthritis and household out-of-pocket medical spending in four harmonised ageing cohorts (HRS, SHARE, MHAS, LASI; 25 waves; 576,020 person-waves), with CHARLS as an extension cohort.

The pipeline covers variable discovery, wave-by-wave feasibility checks, construction of the person-wave analysis file, a two-part model (probability of any spending; amount among spenders) estimated cohort by cohort and synthesised by DerSimonian-Laird random effects, decomposition of the excess by service component, an event-study description of spending around first reported arthritis, country-level consistency and ecological meta-regression, and income-quintile and education effect-modification analyses with Benjamini-Hochberg control.

No respondent-level data are included. Source data are distributed by the Gateway to Global Aging Data and the cohort programmes under their own data-use agreements; the scripts are read-only and expect a local PostgreSQL instance holding the harmonised files.
